jobs.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.

Are you looking for a new challenging role where you can have a positive impact on digital transformation journey's ?

Join Capgemini as a SAP Solution Architect, and establish a long term relationship with our major customer, helping them optimizing their SAP transformation journeys.

 

CONTEXT

• As an End to End Solution Architect within Capgemini, your role is to help our clients in crafting, modelling and delivering a working end to end solution within one or more business domains.
• As a solution architect, you are involved in all aspects of an SAP project. During the design phase, you take the lead in creating a vision and a high-level solution, as a playing field for the different functional teams. During the build phase, you closely align with the technical architects to deliver a working solution, while monitoring the functional teams so that everyone adheres to the overall vision and solution. During the prep of the Go Live and the Go Live itself, you take the lead in guiding the client towards a successful transition and a smooth start-up.
• You work in tandem with the project manager, in a joint responsibility for the success of the project in scope, timeline and budget. You provide tactical input towards the steering committee, the delivery manager and the account manager. As part of the core team for a project or customer, you are the face of Capgemini and try to defend our interests, while delivering according to client expectations.
• Your role is to drive excellence for our clients through innovative (standard) SAP solutions crafting and strategic leadership and vision, optimizing performance and processes for sustainable business success.
 

YOUR ROLE

• Solution Design: collaborate with cross-functional teams to craft, design and implement a new and effective SAP-based solution that aligns with business objectives and best practices, based on SAP’s on-premise and cloud portfolio of solutions.
• Project Leadership: work closely together with the project manager and lead the functional teams, overseeing the entire project lifecycle from a solution and delivery perspective, ensuring high quality delivery according to client expectations, but also timely and within budget.
• System Configuration: keep in touch with the system and the latest SAP solutions and toolsets, in order to support our functional teams to configure and customize SAP to meet specific organizational requirements, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems and processes in or out of SAP; while sticking as close as possible to the standard of SAP
• Team Management: manage and mentor consultants of various levels of expertise; providing guidance, training, and support to enhance their skills and contribute to project success
• Internal management and contributions: As a senior colleague within Capgemini, you actively follow the latest developments, roadmaps, toolsets and strategic visions of SAP, and you actively share your findings within the Architecture Community and beyond.

YOUR PROFILE

• 10+ years of SAP project experience in a line of business, a sector or a solution suite, with proven knowledge in a SAP solution design and solution architect role
• Extensive knowledge of the latest SAP technology portfolio, on-premise, in the cloud (BTP, CALM,...) and ecosystem for your domain of expertise, and how to apply them in a clean core approach
• Knowledge of common non-SAP technologies that are used your domain of expertise, such as : GIS, Copperleaf, IoT, Field Service Management, transport management solutions, ServiceNow, integration platforms, automated warehouse management solutions, …
• A collaborative spirit & customer-oriented attitude, being able to lead both internally and externally
• Result-driven & focused on delivering quality, within the boundaries of a project and a contract
• Fluency in Dutch or French is mandatory and professional working proficiency in English

Talencia is currently looking for a Cybersecurity Incident Response Specialist for one of their important clients, leader on the market. You will join a highly skilled and innovative team where collaboration, expertise, and growth are part of the culture.

Your role

• Investigate and respond to advanced security incidents: malware analysis, IoC extraction, forensic investigations, breach analysis
• Manage and resolve client requests while coordinating incident, change, and use-case tickets
• Take ownership of end-to-end response activities; from detection and analysis to reporting and recommendations
• Support customers with readiness assessments, audits, and tailored consultancy
• Contribute to the wider cybersecurity community and share knowledge at industry events
• Dedicate time each month to self-learning and technical exploration
• 
Ensure strict compliance with data protection, security frameworks, and best practices

 

What you bring

• At least 5 years of experience in cybersecurity, preferably in incident response
• Strong analytical, forensic, and problem-solving skills
• Fluent in French, Dutch and English
• Organized, detail-oriented, with strong reporting and documentation habits
• A collaborative mindset and willingness to mentor junior colleagues
• Passion for continuous learning in a fast-evolving field

Are you fascinated by Data?

Do you like to dig into it to find trends?

Are you looking for a rewarding and learning experience?

If so, join ACENSI as a Data Analyst!

What will you do?

• Extracting data from internal databases
• Collect, clean, structure customer data
• Analyse trends in the collected data
• Create clear and concise reports from the analysed data
• 
Enriching data sources

 

What are your skills ?

• You have experience in data processing, data analytics
• You have good knowledge of SQL, Python and PowerBI
• You have a good knowledge of Excel
• You possess a strong analytical mind
• You have good communication skills and can explain in a concise way complex information
• You speak English and French fluently. Speaking Dutch would be an asset

Are you an experienced tester?

Do you like catching bugs and help produce the best possible IT solution?

Do you want to be part of a company that will help you to grow and gain skills?

If so, join ACENSI as a Manual Tester!

 

What will you do?

• Participate in test strategy and design
• Develop and implement test tools
• Create test data, write procedures
• Run test cases
• Write test plans
• Perform the test review
• 
Perform non-functional tests (Performance testing, Security testing, scalability testing...)

 

What are your skills ?

• You have 2 years minimum of experience in testing
• You have knowledge of test phases and types (functional and non-functional testing)
• You have experience with: Rest, Soap, SoapUI, Json
• ISTQB certification is an asset
• You speak English and French fluently. Speaking Dutch is an asset

Introduction
As a Network Engineer, you are responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining secure and reliable network infrastructures. You ensure optimal connectivity, performance, and scalability across LAN, WAN, and cloud environments, enabling seamless communication for business-critical operations.
Your responsibilities include:
• Designing and configuring network architectures for on-premises and cloud environments.
• Managing routers, switches, firewalls, and load balancers.
• Monitoring network performance and troubleshooting connectivity issues.
• Implementing security measures and ensuring compliance with standards.
• Supporting network automation and integration with CI/CD pipelines.
• Collaborating with system engineers, architects, and security teams.
• 
Documenting network configurations and operational procedures.

 

What we expect from you:
• At least 1 year of experience as a Network Engineer or similar role. If you have more experience, we'll contact you for more experienced roles.
• Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), and VLANs.
• Experience with firewalls, VPNs, and network security principles.
• Familiarity with cloud networking (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
• Knowledge of automation tools (Python, Ansible) and monitoring solutions.
• Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
• 
Fluent in English and Dutch or French.

As part of our strong growth, we are looking to strengthen the consulting CIO advisory team, which is deeply involved in the issues at the heart of digital transformation that affect all businesses.

This team advises our clients' CIOs and leaders on the right direction to take on their digital transformation journeys in various sectors (public, healthcare, industry, and E&U).

You will work with our clients to help them to:

• Define their digital & IT strategy and identify the technology levers at the heart of business transformation
• Structure complex business and IT landscapes to deliver business and IT insights
• Advise our customers in their cloud adoption journey, helping them choose directions that bring true value
• Define and deliver major digital transformation programmes or projects
• Transform operating models to achieve greater agility
• Assess IT M&A opportunities and support their implementation
• Analyse and optimise IT performance across the business
Our work includes recurring and key topics at the heart of digital transformation, such as go-to cloud strategy and deployment, sustainable IT, testing and scaling innovative technologies (GenAI, blockchain, IoT, ...).

At Inetum Consulting, we still value diversity and inclusion as fundamental pillars of our culture. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

As a Principal Consultant, you will also have a business development dimension to your role. You will contribute to prospecting, referrals, proposal writing, and expanding our current portfolio of offerings.

 

Profile

• You are a graduate of a leading business school, engineering school, or university.
• You have 5 years or more experience in the context of digital & IT transformation.
• You have a broad technical background.
• You have a consulting mindset.
• You have a proven track record in taking the lead in digital projects.
• You have skills and an appetite for digital, cloud, new technologies, and innovation.
• You have a consulting mindset and are eager to contribute to a growing organisation.
• You are fluent in English and Dutch or French and have a good knowledge of Dutch or French.
• 
You have strong analytical, summarising, interpersonal, and teaching skills.

At Secamo, we help organizations build cyber resilience through strategy, controls, and continuous monitoring — across IT, OT, and cloud environments. To support our growth, we’re looking for a motivated professional to join our team.

Location: Hybrid (offices in Gent and Antwerp + remote)
Your role
As an all-round System Administrator, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the stability, security, and efficiency of our clients’ IT infrastructure. You will implement robust solutions, proactively prevent disruptions, and ensure business continuity across our customers’ operations. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining a resilient and secure technology landscape that supports Secamo’s mission of delivering trusted cybersecurity services and managed services to our clients.

 
What you’ll do
• Infrastructure Management: Oversee and maintain the organization’s IT infrastructure, ensuring optimal performance, security, and scalability.
• Windows Server Administration: Manage and support Windows Server environments, including Active Directory, DNS and DHCP.
• Microsoft 365 Administration: Administer Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, and Intune, ensuring seamless integration and user support.
• Automate tasks with PowerShell (and optionally Python)
• Backup and Disaster Recovery: Implement and manage backup solutions, conduct regular DR testing, and ensure quick recovery in case of system failures.
• Security Implementation: Apply security best practices to protect systems and data, including patch management, system hardening and vulnerability assessments.
• Collaboration with Teams: Work closely with other IT teams and departments to ensure alignment of systems with organizational goals and compliance requirements.
• Documentation and Reporting: Maintain comprehensive documentation of systems, configurations, and procedures; provide regular reports on system performance and incidents.
 

What we are looking for
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent experience
• Proven experience in system administration, particularly with Windows Server environments and Microsoft 365. Knowledge of Linux is an asset.
• Strong knowledge of backup solutions, disaster recovery planning, and implementation.
• Ability to troubleshoot complex issues and implement effective solutions.
• Strong verbal and written communication skills to interact with stakeholders and document processes effectively.
• Ability to work autonomously and collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.
• Fluent in English and Dutch. French is a nice-to-have.

At Secamo, we help organizations build cyber resilience through strategy, controls, and continuous monitoring — across IT, OT, and cloud environments. To support our growth, we’re looking for a motivated professional to join our team.

Location: Offices in Gent and Antwerp
Your role
As a Cybersecurity Strategy Consultant, you will play a pivotal role advising our clients on how to align their security posture with business goals, regulatory requirements, and the evolving threat landscape. You will lead strategic cybersecurity engagements, shape frameworks and roadmaps, and partner closely with senior leaders (C-suite, IT leadership, operations, OT, risk) to translate strategy into action. We’re specifically looking for a strategy consultant who also brings hands-on technical experience and can bridge the gap between strategy and execution.

 
What you’ll do
• Assess client cybersecurity maturity (IT, OT, Cloud), identify gaps, recommend improvements, and define prioritized initiatives.
• Design and refine governance, risk & compliance (GRC) frameworks suited to client risk appetite and regulatory context.
• Collaborate with technical teams to ensure strategy is actionable: helping translate strategic objectives into measurable control implementations.
• Provide thought leadership and subject-matter expertise: staying current with cyber-threat trends, regulatory developments (e.g. GDPR, NIS2, etc.), and emerging best practices.
• Support the implementation and monitoring of cybersecurity metrics, KPIs, and metrics dashboards, to enable transparent reporting at executive, managerial, and operational levels.
• Mentor and guide more junior consultants in strategic thinking, stakeholder engagement, and problem solving.
 

What we are looking for
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems or related field.
• 8+ years of experience in cybersecurity strategy, risk management, security governance, or related consulting roles.
• Experience across IT, OT (Operational Technology), and Cloud environments. Deep understanding of cybersecurity frameworks, regulatory compliance, threat landscape, incident response, and cyber resilience.
• Demonstrated technical, hands-on experience (e.g. incident response, forensics, ethical hacking, or other technical cybersecurity analysis).
• Strong consultancy skills and excellent communication skills (written & verbal) in English and Dutch.
• Ability to work in ambiguous environments, define priorities, and deliver strategic clarity.

Ready to take your Tech career to the next level?

What’s in it for you?

Your role:

What we’re looking for:

• 2-5 years of experience

Are you a passionate machine learning engineer with expertise in generative AI? Join our Machine Learning Enablers team at Proximus Ada, where you’ll play a key role in advancing and scaling generative AI capabilities across teams. You will leverage your expertise in architectures such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agent-based systems to develop and maintain reusable components and templates that enable data scientists to deliver impactful solutions. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with data scientists in delivery teams and engineers from our Cloud and DevSecOps teams to implement best practices and ensure technical excellence across multiple projects. Using frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph and our Azure-first stack, you will maintain and expand a shared repository of reusable generative AI assets that enable scalable, reliable solutions. 

Your innovative mindset will help identify emerging techniques and translate them into practical building blocks that deliver business value, keeping our teams aligned with the latest advances. Your work will support the day-to-day needs of our data scientists through the practical maintenance, hands-on support, and enhancement of shared assets, while also driving innovation in our generative AI initiatives. 

Responsibilities 

Develop and Maintain our Generative AI Repository 

• Manage and expand our shared repository of reusable Generative AI components and templates, ensuring it is robust, up-to-date, well-documented, and easy to adopt across use cases. 
• Support onboarding and adoption: help teams use the repository effectively, keep alignment with the main branch, and facilitate clean integration of shared changes. 
• Collaborate with data scientists to identify new components to build, provide technical support, and promote best practices in using the repository. 
• Drive key upgrades and migrations of core libraries and templates (e.g., LangChain/LangGraph) with minimal disruption to delivery teams. 
Enable Agent-Based and Generative AI Solutions 

• Guide delivery teams on architectures such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agent-based systems, providing hands-on technical support and troubleshooting when needed. 
• Research and prototype emerging techniques, frameworks, and Azure services; translate validated approaches into reusable building blocks for delivery teams. 
Collaborate and Drive Technical Excellence 

• Define and promote software engineering best practices for Generative AI solutions (testing, code quality, style, automation) and enforce them through PR reviews and shared standards. 
• Collaborate with Cloud, DevSecOps, enterprise architecture, and vendors to ensure solutions and technologies align with our stack and constraints.
• Stay current with advances in Generative AI and communicate relevant learnings and recommendations to the organization. 
 

Profile

Education 

• Master’s degree in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field. 
• A Ph.D. is a plus, especially with research in Generative AI or agent-based systems. 
Professional Experience 

• Minimum of 2+ years of relevant experience in a business environment in AI/ML engineering or software engineering.
• Proven experience working with generative AI models and LLMs in real-world projects. 
• Demonstrated ability to build reusable components and templates, and transition proof-of-concepts into production-ready assets. 
• Experience collaborating with delivery teams and stakeholders, providing technical guidance and support. 
Technical Skills 

• Strong coding skills in Python, with solid software engineering best practices (testing, code quality, documentation, maintainable design). 
• Proficiency with version control (Git) and modern development workflows, including CI/CD pipelines. 
• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and relevant Azure Data & AI services. 
• Experience with Generative AI frameworks such as LangChain; familiarity with LangGraph is a plus. 
• Experience implementing MLOps best practices (e.g., experiment tracking with MLflow). 
• Familiarity with monitoring and evaluation practices for Generative AI applications. 
Soft Skills 

• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with attention to detail.
• Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts, provide actionable guidance, and produce high-quality documentation. 
• Collaboration and enablement mindset: comfortable supporting and mentoring others through code reviews and hands-on troubleshooting. 
• Ownership and autonomy: able to prioritize effectively and drive work to completion in a transversal context. 
• Curiosity and innovation mindset: proactive in exploring new techniques and translating them into practical improvements. 
Languages 

• Fluent in English and preferably also French and/or Dutch.

As an AI Architect, you design solutions AI solutions for our clients that require traditional, generative, and agentic AI. You align with stakeholders to capture requirements and to design solutions and reference architectures in line with the necessary requirements.  

You work in close collaboration with Product Owners, Project Managers, Data Managers, Cloud Architects, Security Architects, and AI Experts, amongst others, to design compliant solutions that meet current and future requirements. You can translate high-level requirements into concrete solutions and make and explain the necessary tradeoffs. 

 

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in AI consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. You will be part of the Data & AI team, where we tackle AI challenges end to end, from strategy, governance, to science and engineering. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application! 

You’ll have knowledge and experience of the following: 

• At least 10 years of experience in the industry, with 5 years of experience as an AI Architect or in a similar position 
• Experience with traditional AI, NLP, LLMs, and Agentic AI solutions 
• Comfortable with the machine learning lifecycle and MLOps and DevOps principles 
• Experience with modern Data & AI platforms 
• Experience with at least one cloud provider and good knowledge of the data ecosystem 
• Strong communication skills and stakeholder management skills
• Master or PhD in Computer Engineering, IT, Artificial Intelligence, or related field
• TOGAF, AI, and Data certifications are a plus 
• You are proficient in English, and in Dutch or French

jobs.occupation: Cloud Engineer ( Data Science) | Proximus Ada
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Cloud Engineer with a strong background in DevOps, MLOps, and cloud architecture (Azure) to join our team. You will play a pivotal role in designing, deploying, and scaling cloud-based AI and data solutions, leveraging Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and modern DevOps practices. Your expertise will help us deliver robust platforms and services for a wide range of client projects, ensuring security, scalability, and operational excellence. 

Responsibilities 

• Architect and design cloud solutions and platforms (Azure), translating business needs into scalable, secure, and cost-effective architectures. 
• Automating everything related to the ML lifecycle to ensure efficiency and scalability. 
• Using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices, such as Bicep, to manage and provision resources through code. 
• Implementing best practices for continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, ensuring that ML models are reliably deployed to production environments. 
• Collaborate with data scientists, AI engineers, and business stakeholders to define requirements, select technologies, and deliver end-to-end solutions. 
• Challenge our existing security and reinforce our defenses 
 

Profile

• Master's degree in computer science, data science, engineering, or related field. 
• At least 2 years of experience in data engineering, data science, or related roles. 
• Proficient in Python. 
• Hands-on experience with Azure cloud services, including IaC (Bicep), CI/CD, and cloud security. 
• Knowledge on containerized deployment of ML products – e.g. docker, podman, Kubernetes 
• Excellent communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills. 
• 
Fluent in English. Dutch and/or French is considered as a plus.

SQL DBA – Banking Sector

You will play a key role in ensuring that our database environments are highly available, secure, performant, and scalable, while collaborating closely with infrastructure and development teams.

• Design, implement, and maintain highly available and scalable database systems aligned with business and regulatory requirements
• Ensure smooth operation, maintenance, and upgrades of database platforms (backups, transaction logs, indexing, performance tuning, etc.)

• Participate actively in IT Operations (on-call/operational duties approximately 1 day per week)

• Investigate and resolve performance issues and functional incidents in collaboration with application teams
• Maintain and improve deployment pipelines and promote best practices across teams

• Familiarity with Go (Golang)

Basic experience with F5 load balancers

Who are we?

In today’s digital world, organizations need to shift their approach to cyber security. Prevention alone is no longer sufficient. The ability to rapidly detect and respond to threats is essential. Organizations are increasingly turning to trusted strategic partners who can fully unburden them in the domain of detection and response.

That’s where we come in. We offer MDR as a value service to a broad spectrum of customers across different verticals – all equally exciting.

Based in Belgium and the Netherlands, we help companies navigate the digital era and make data-driven decisions with confidence. We proudly serve clients in the top 200 across the Benelux, spanning a wide range of fascinating and diverse sectors.

At Davinsi Labs, we love to inspire each other, collaborate closely, and pursue excellence together. We are building a workplace where fulfillment and happiness take center stage.

Your mission: what can you expect from the job?

You will join our Managed Detection & Response (MDR) teams with a strong focus on security automation and orchestration. As a Security Automation Engineer, your primary responsibility is to design, build, and maintain automated response capabilities using Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR.

Your work will directly impact how efficiently and consistently security incidents are handled across complex customer environments. You will help scale our MDR service by translating detection signals into automated, reliable, and auditable response workflows.

We strongly believe in SOAR as code: automation content is version-controlled, tested, and continuously improved.

You will contribute to and integrate with the following technologies:

• Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR
• Microsoft Defender XDR and other XDR platforms
• SIEM platforms (Microsoft Sentinel and others)
• ITSM platforms (ServiceNow and equivalents)
• Cloud, identity, network, and third-party security tooling
Key Responsibilities

Security Automation & Playbook Development

• Design, build, and maintain response playbooks in Cortex XSOAR for common and advanced security incidents.
• Translate detection alerts from SIEM and XDR platforms into automated investigation and response flows.
• Implement conditional logic, enrichment steps, human-in-the-loop approvals, and automated containment actions.
SOAR as Code

• Manage playbooks, integrations, scripts, and content packs using version control (Git).
• Apply software engineering best practices such as modularity, reusability, testing, and peer review.
• Contribute to standardized automation frameworks that can be reused across customers.
Platform Integrations

• Build and maintain integrations between XSOAR and:
• SIEM platforms o XDR / EDR solutions
• ITSM tools (incident creation, updates, closures) o Identity, network, and cloud security controls
• Troubleshoot and optimize integrations for reliability, performance, and scalability.
Incident Response Enablement

• Collaborate closely with Detection Engineering and Incident Response teams to define:
• Automated investigation steps o Response actions and containment strategies o Escalation and handover points to analysts
• Continuously improve response quality based on real incident feedback.
Automation Lifecycle Management

• Maintain and evolve our automation content library.
• Tune playbooks to reduce noise, false positives, and manual 

Hello, is it me you’re looking for?

• You are passionate about IT security and automation, with several years of relevant professional experience.
• You have hands-on experience with SOAR platforms, preferably Palo Alto Cortex XSOAR.
• You are comfortable building response playbooks and automations end-toend.
• You strongly believe in automation as code and have experience with Gitbased workflows.
• Basic system engineering knowledge (Windows, Linux, networking, identity) is a plus.
• You have experience integrating security platforms such as SIEM, XDR, EDR, IAM, or ITSM tools.
• You understand security operations and incident response processes.
• Experience with scripting (Python, JavaScript) is a strong plus.
• You communicate smoothly in Dutch and English (written and oral). French is a plus.
• 
You are analytical, structured, and not afraid to challenge existing processes to improve them.
